game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes, dunes at sunset: the desert nomad must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sunset Dunes: dunes at sunset
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Week 3 examination practice: Algorithm synthesis: add 14 to each value. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 2, operand 14.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sunset Dunes'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the supply tent from dust devils in Sunset Dunes: keep the speed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: speed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
